context: a single passage from a letter by Charles Lyell, which you are answering on its own
exchanges: Hooker asked me whether I was confounded by your migration of many European plants from N. to S. across the intermediate tropical zone by aid of mountain chains during glacial period. I told him I was by no means staggered by it. Indeed the necessity of expecting a vast number of difficulties of this kind was fully appreciated by me long ago. I rather marvel at the extent to which the non-intermixture of provinces holds good, assuming single birthplace of species.
I believe, as you will see when you reread, that some plants migrated through Tropical lowlands during glacial period.
